content.title: Paranovus Entertainment receives delisting notification from Nasdaq
content.summary: Paranovus Entertainment (PAVS) announced that the company received a letter from Nasdaq, notifying the company that the Nasdaq staff has determined to delist the company’s Class A ordinary shares from Nasdaq because the company failed to comply with the Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810. The trading of the company’s Class A ordinary shares will be suspended at the opening of business on December 29 unless the company duly requests an appeal of this determination.
